text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I apologize. I was defeated 
this time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: However, there is no time to feel down.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"If you stay down in the dumps all the 
time, your food just won't taste as good."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Next time, I'll show you a win. 
...Hm?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A message arrived on the phone. It was 
from everyone back home.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"That was a great run. Good luck next time 
too," they said...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Next time for sure, I want to show 
everyone what it looks like when I take 
first place, Trainer."

Upon receiving the message, Oguri Cap 
seemed to renew her determination to win.

Together with a highly motivated Oguri 
Cap, we dedicated ourselves entirely to 
training.
